field_meaning.hi: दुर्घटना पीड़ितों की मदद करने वालों की सुरक्षा कानून।

review_objections: Alibaba: Topic mismatch. Good Samaritan laws are generally found in medical or general liability contexts, not specifically in the Motor Vehicles Act (though related to accidents, the term itself is not a defined term in the MVA).
